newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hsin Chong says not in stake sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Hsin Chong says not in stake sale talk.

text.p: Hsin Chong Construction Group Ltd said on Thursday it was not in talks with any party regarding sale or purchase of a company stake or assets.

"Neither the company nor its substantial shareholders is in negotiations with any party regarding the acquisition or disposal by the company of any businesses or assets," Hsin Chong said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange.
The construction group said they made the statement in response to speculation and market rumours linking the company with certain mainland Chinese firms.
Rumours that a Chinese firm was interested in taking a stake in the company had boosted Hsin Chong shares by HK$0.59 or 40.41 percent to HK$2.05 at midday on Thursday.
Volume was 75.72 million shares worth HK$153.60 million.
